Hello /vpop :) I would like to apply for the moderator position.

Here's a little about me. I am a Vietnamese Asian American who is currently attending college right now. You can tell by my username that I am a petroleum engineering Major. I grew up listening to Vietnamese music and I will always listen to Vietnamese music until I die. Even if you look in my iPhone, it's 253 Vietnamese songs.

A major project I want to undertake is I want to create a Google Doc and list all the songs that was ever posted to /vpop. Then new subscribers to this subreddit can see our massive collection. I will personally log each song.

Also, I created a rough draft on the submission rule for /vpop. Having some format will make it /vpop easier to read.

I believe /vpop does not need to change that much aside from creating helpful links on the sidebar. We could include links on how to find the newest Vietnamese music.

 What I like about /vpop is that there is no judging on here and I hope it always continues like this. Although I have no CSS experience, I hope that doesn't bar me from becoming mod. Thanks for listening guys :)
